findings.report:
ERROR: deslag detected banned characters!

README.md has 2 banned characters.

This repo writes in plain characters, and each of these has a plain equivalent. Write it as listed, or reword: an em dash often reads better as a comma, a colon, parentheses or a new sentence.

Code is not checked, so a diagram may use these characters in a code block.

Do not write the characters as HTML entities, and do not change the config to get past this check. Only a human can tell you to do that, and I am a linter, not a human.

The characters, and what to write instead:
  line 3: U+2014 em dash "—"; write `-`
  line 3: U+00A0 no-break space; write a plain space

exemptions.report:
ERROR: deslag detected an exemption that does not hold!

deslag.toml has md.allow[0], which exempts a sentence of README.md from `banned_chars`. It fails: README.md does not hold a sentence equal to the quote, spaces and line breaks aside. The sentence was reworded, or moved out of the text deslag reads.

The quote: "The title — a dated record."
The reason: "A quoted title; a no-break space was added later."

The sentences of README.md that hold a finding of `banned_chars`:
  line 3: "The title — a<U+00A0>dated record."

An entry that does not hold may be deleted; that only tightens the check. Never write or change an entry: only a human exempts a sentence. Leave the sentence as it is, and give the human its text and a reason. Rewording a sentence only to get past a lint is no fix.
